A folder shared by 1.4 and 1.3.3 (plan C1). Do not edit by hand: every byte of the two device files is what one version of the app wrote.
devices/494df668-3488-4f75-9100-8e12ce3c6f80.json is Studio (1.4), written by the 1.4 code on 2026-03-02 at 09:48 (fake clock): a task "Design review" with tags tag-concept, tag-admin and tag-revision, 20 minutes on its subtask Wireframes, 15 on Copy and 10 on no subtask, then Wireframes given tag-concept, Copy given tag-admin, and Sign-off given tag-revision and put back on "Same as task" (a null entry). ../cloud-1.4.0-mixed.identity.json is Studio's identity and folder (/cloud/OneDrive), with no data: a test's first start takes its data from this folder.
devices/ddf1d96b-c78e-4b66-91f5-bbd6e1fa5d4a.json is Office PC (1.3.3), written by the code of commit fd51d79 (1.3.3, taken with git archive) on 2026-03-03 at 10:03 (fake clock), after it read Studio's file, renamed the task "Design review (renamed on 1.3.3)", took tag-admin off it, and entered 09:00-09:30 that day by hand on Wireframes. It holds no subtaskTags: 1.3.3 drops the field.
Ids are random (each version drew its own). The generators are kept outside the repository, in .stack/out/rust-expert/c1-gen-1.4-side.rs.txt (run on the 1.4 code) and c1-gen-1.3.3-side.rs.txt (run on fd51d79, with Studio's file as input).
